model.name: HDRi Skybox
model.shortDescription: Convert a standard skybox image into an HDRi environment, saved as EXR and HDR files, with optional cubemap output.

inputs.description: The standard (low-dynamic-range) skybox image you want to convert into an HDRi environment.
inputs.label: Skybox Image
inputs.name: image

inputs.description: Saves the result as an OpenEXR file (.exr) - a high-dynamic-range format widely used in 3D and VFX software.
inputs.label: Output EXR
inputs.name: outputExr

inputs.description: Saves the result as a Radiance HDR file (.hdr) - a common high-dynamic-range format for environment lighting.
inputs.label: Output HDR
inputs.name: outputHdr

inputs.description: Also outputs a cubemap in "cross" layout: the six faces of the environment unfolded into a single cross-shaped image. Applies to the input and all generated outputs.
inputs.label: Conversion Cubemap Cross
inputs.name: conversionCubemapCross

inputs.description: Also outputs a cubemap as six separate square face images. Applies to the input and all generated outputs.
inputs.label: Conversion Cubemap Faces
inputs.name: conversionCubemapFaces
